name: 赭红·编辑
description: 源自 rico-md 的「赭红·编辑」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px 18px 50px 18px; font-family: Georgia, Noto Serif SC, Songti SC, Garamond, serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.82; color: {{text}}; background-color: #faf8f2; word-wrap: break-word">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.3; margin: 28px 0 16px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-align: center; font-family: Georgia, Didot, serif">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 400; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.4; margin: 24px 0 12px; border-top: 1px solid {{heading}}; border-bottom: 1px solid {{heading}}; padding: 10px 0; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-family: Georgia, Didot, serif">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.45; margin: 20px 0 10px; font-family: Georgia, Didot, serif">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.5; margin: 18px 0 8px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background-color: {{codeBg}}; padding: 10px 14px; text-align: left; border-top: 2px solid {{heading}}; border-bottom: 2px solid {{heading}}; font-weight: 700; color: {{text}}; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 12px">{{content}}</th>

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 28px auto; border: none; height: 1px; background-color: {{heading}}; max-width: 80px">
